bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of vision-language models trained on English-only versus translated multilingual image-text pairs to measure the impact of monolingual (English-centric) data curation.
Measuring zero-shot object recognition accuracy across six different global regions (e.g., Africa, Europe, Southeast Asia) using the geographically diverse GeoDE dataset.
Evaluating image classification accuracy across different household monthly income levels using the Dollar Street dataset.

Analyzing the representation of culturally salient concepts and distinguishing visual/textual distributions of English vs. non-English origins using SVM image classifiers and MAUVE text divergence scores.
